name: [UPDATE 1 + CODES] Deadly Sins Retribution
desc:
Welcome! In this world, you can learn Magic, fight Enemies, and Master your Sins!

CONTROLS:
    Click to use Combat
    Q + W/A/S/D to Dash in direction of the key (Mouse lock is recommended)
    R to Block
    Ctrl/Control to Run
    E to Equip Weapon from the waist
    F to Interact with objects/NPCs
    M to Open Menu

Update Notes:
- Listed in the update log , in the game's chat.
